mapper.sql: id, user_id, assessment_id, nickname, age, gender, grade, city, stage, mbti, holland_code, completeness, summary, summary_status, profile_json, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: select count(1) from user_profile where user_id = #{userId}
select from user_profile where user_id = #{userId} for update
mapper.insert: insert into user_profile (user_id, assessment_id, nickname, age, gender, grade, city, stage, mbti, holland_code, completeness, summary, summary_status, profile_json, created_at, updated_at) values (#{userId}, #{assessmentId}, #{nickname}, #{age}, #{gender}, #{grade}, #{city}, #{stage}, #{mbti}, #{hollandCode}, #{completeness}, #{summary}, #{summaryStatus}, #{profileJson}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
